caption: The drawing depicts an upholstered chaise lounge with an elaborately carved wooden frame. The wood is depicted in brown tones and features intricate decorative carvings, especially along the top backrest and sides. The upholstery is a muted green color, covering both the seat and backrest, with some shading to suggest texture and lighting. The seat is wide and rounded, while the backrest curves in an asymmetrical shape, higher on the left and dipping lower to the right, following the scrollwork of the wooden frame. The piece stands on four curved legs, also featuring carved details. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or patterns present.
title: Love Seat
